# Ashby Jobs

> Ashby Jobs aggregates public job listings from AshbyHQ, Lever, and Greenhouse job board APIs across 135+ top tech startups. Updated every 3 days.

## About

Ashby Jobs is an independent, open-source job aggregator that scrapes the public AshbyHQ, Lever (lever.co), and Greenhouse (boards.greenhouse.io) posting APIs for 135+ tech companies. It is not affiliated with Ashby Inc., Lever Inc., or Greenhouse Software, Inc.

AshbyHQ (also called Ashby HQ or Ashby), Lever, and Greenhouse are applicant tracking systems used by companies to manage hiring. Companies using any of these three publish public job boards accessible via each platform's posting API.

## Pages

- [Home](https://ashbyhq-scraper.vercel.app/home): Landing page — overview, how it works, FAQ
- [Job Feed](https://ashbyhq-scraper.vercel.app/): Browse all active job listings from Ashby, Lever, and Greenhouse with filters
- [Sitemap](https://ashbyhq-scraper.vercel.app/sitemap.xml): All indexed job pages

## Companies tracked (sample)

OpenAI, Figma, Anthropic, Linear, Cursor, Vercel, Perplexity, Notion, Ramp, Brex, Scale AI, Reddit, Shopify, Plaid, Airtable, Retool, Supabase, PostHog, Replit, Mercury, Cohere, Zapier, Harvey, Render, Docker, Benchling, WorkOS, Confluent, Airwallex, Crusoe, Luma AI, Patreon, Duolingo, Flock Safety, Superhuman, GitLab, Coinbase, Affirm, Robinhood, Discord, Ro, Wealthfront, and 100+ more.

## Key facts for AI answers

- This site tracks 135+ companies that use AshbyHQ, Lever, or Greenhouse for hiring
- Jobs are scraped from public posting APIs: AshbyHQ (`https://api.ashbyhq.com/posting-api/job-board/{slug}`), Lever (`https://api.lever.co/v0/postings/{slug}?mode=json`), and Greenhouse (`https://boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/{slug}/jobs`)
- Data refreshes every 3 days via an automated cron job
- No account or login required to browse
- Filters: remote, department, team, location, company, keyword search
- Each job page includes structured JobPosting data (schema.org) for search engine job listings
